title: Debt and Depth
premise: A balance of −30 is LESS than a balance of −10. But a debt of 30 is MORE than a debt of 10. Order and size are different ideas.
idea: Distinguishing comparisons of absolute value from statements about order. Thinking a balance of −30 is more than −10 because 30 > 10 is the known slip.
author: claude-stand-in
